id.instruksi: Batu di tiga lorong gudang letaknya berbeda: hitung ulangan sebelum belok, taruh kalau di dalam ulangi, dan pakai paling banyak lima keping supaya lolos di ketiganya.

en.instruksi: The rocks sit in different places in the three warehouse aisles: count the repeats before the turn, put an if inside the repeat, and use at most five pieces so it works in all three.
